title: Italian Hummus Panini
description: A twist on the classic panini, featuring Italian-style ingredients and a creamy hummus spread.
instructions: 1. Preheat a panini press or grill to medium-high heat.
2. Spread 1-2 tbsp of hummus on the inside of each wrap.
3. Top the hummus with a slice of prosciutto, a handful of arugula, and a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese.
4. Drizzle the top with olive oil and season with salt.
5. Place the wraps in the press or grill and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until crispy and golden.
